design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #09090B; --surface: #17171C; --surface-alt: #25252C; --text: #FFF1F2; --muted: #D4BEC3; --primary: #E11D48; --accent: #2DD4BF; --on-primary: #FFFFFF; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 6px; --gap: 16px; --blur: 20px; --nav-position: fixed; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Roboto Flex', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .hero { min-height: clamp(720px, 92vh, 980px); display: grid; align-items: end; padding: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); } .hero__copy { max-width: 760px; } .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 8vw, 8.5rem); letter-spacing: -0.08em; line-height: .84; } .premium-frame { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 18%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; opacity: .035; z-index: 80; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
